blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte appeared before the Quezon City Regional Trial Court on Friday for her arraignment on three counts of grave threats. Duterte is expected to be formally informed of the charges and asked to enter a plea of guilty or not guilty during the proceedings before Branch 98 of Quezon City RTC. She will also be asked to enter a plea of “guilty” or “not guilty.” If Duterte pleads guilty, the court may proceed toward conviction, while a not-guilty plea will lead to the trial proper.
